page: Microsoft Azure FX8-4mds_v2 is a specialized virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V platform, engineered for workloads requiring high single-core frequency coupled with an unusually high memory-to-core allocation. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor clocked at 4.2 GHz, the instance provisions 2 physical cores mapped to 4 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. The configuration is equipped with 168.0 GB of system RAM, yielding an expansive 42.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include an L3 cache of 260 MB, support for AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions, and an integrated 472 GB local NVMe SSD for high-speed scratch space. Discrete graphics processing units are not included.

Performance benchmarks show notable divergence between single-threaded velocity and parallel capacity. In Geekbench testing, the instance scored 2355.0 in single-core evaluation, placing it in the top decile, supported by strong results in single-threaded gzip compression at 34.91 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.41 GB/sec. Conversely, overall multi-core throughput is constrained by the physical four-thread topology, registering average to lower-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Clang software compilation. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reached 36.17 GB/sec, while in-memory operations showed steady throughput with Redis SET operations achieving 6.31 million operations per second.

From an efficiency perspective, the FX8-4mds_v2 delivers strong qualitative value for environments where commercial database or application software is licensed on a per-core metric. By maximizing available system memory per compute thread without incurring costs for unneeded CPU licenses, the instance limits licensing overhead while maintaining rapid query responsiveness. Primary tradeoffs center on limited total compute parallelism and modest uncached memory transfer rates. This server is best suited for memory-intensive relational databases, in-memory caches, electronic design automation tooling, financial risk simulations, and analytical jobs that rely heavily on single-thread clock speed.
description: Microsoft Azure FX8-4mds_v2 is a specialized virtual machine configuration pairing high clock speeds with an extensive memory footprint. Driven by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz across 2 physical cores and 4 vCPUs, the instance supplies 168.0 GB of RAM alongside a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD. It features advanced vector instructions including AVX-512 and AMX, but excludes discrete GPUs. Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-core performance, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 2355.0 and strong compression throughput, though multi-threaded scaling is naturally bounded by the low core count. The instance offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for software stacks licensed on a per-core basis that demand massive RAM and high single-threaded responsiveness. This hardware profile is best suited for memory-intensive in-memory caching systems, relational database management systems, batch ETL processing, and financial modeling workloads.
